title: Low-Cal Chinese Noodle Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Honey Soy Tofu and Capsicum
description: Black burger buns, pitch-black lattes... black food is hot stuff right now. Made with activated charcoal powder, these wheat noodles are actually quite mild in flavour, making them the perfect foil for this low-cal stir-fry of capsicum, zucchini and tofu.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Cut the zucchini into 2cm-thick batons. Thinly slice the capsicum. Cut the tofu into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely grate the ginger.
Cook noodles: Cook half the charcoal noodles in the pan of boiling water for 3-4 mins until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold running water to prevent the noodles from sticking.
Make stir-fry sauce: Meanwhile, put half the cumin and coriander spice blend, 1½ tbs soy sauce, 1 tbs barbecue sauce and 2 tsp honey in a bowl and stir to combine. Season with pepper.

Stir-fry veggies and tofu: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a large frypan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the zucchini, capsicum, tofu, ginger and garlic for 2-3 mins until the tofu starts to turn golden.

Serve up: Add the stir-fry sauce and 2 tbs water to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 mins until slightly thickened. Add the noodles and stir-fry for a further 30 secs or until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the stir-fry among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: Add some zing and extra freshness to your noodles with a generous squeeze of lime and a handful of fresh coriander leaves.
